Odd-Paw Vet welcomes viewers to the fantastical town of Odd Springs where odd is good and a range of super-cute hybrid animals reside including Kangaraffe (giraffe-kangaroo), Barrot (parrot-bear), Mummy and Baby Durtle (turtle-duck), Elefrog (elephant-frog), Pigoodle (pig-poodle), Drabbit (dragon-rabbit), and more. When these Odd-Paws need help, it’s up to Billie the Odd-Paw vet and her sidekicks to answer the call to care! 

Odd-Paw Vet follows the adventures of Billie, a young and talented animal doctor. In a world where animals have extraordinary combinations, Billie's days are filled with caring for a special group of animals called Odd-Paws.
Odd-Paws are adorable hybrid animals that have a mix of features from different animals.


Watch Brand New videos every Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday
